pages.text: Points to the crashed ORSA relay satellite, which carries the transponder lead.

pages.title: Use
pages.text: The tower issues the first one. Hold it like a normal compass; it works in the Overworld.$(br2)$(flavor)If it spins, the satellite is unresolved, or ORSA has lost another orbiting asset.$()

pages.title: Recovery Assembly
pages.text: Unlocks after your first issue, for when the original is lost.$(br2)$(flavor)ORSA calls it a recovery build. Finance calls it a training fee.$()
